slides.title: One scroll. 19 MB.
slides.sub: A 5-second scroll-scrub, measured: frames or video, the scroll engine, smooth scroll, and what each costs.

slides.title: Scroll is the playhead.
slides.body: A scroll-scrub section is an animation exported as frames, here **150 of them**. As you scroll, the page shows the frame that matches your position.
slides.close: Two ways to do it: draw frames on a canvas, or set a video's currentTime from the scroll.

slides.title: What it weighs
slides.note: Our Northlight build, 1440×900 frames, measured 17 Oct 2026. AVIF came out bigger than WebP at these settings: test your own frames.

slides.title: Video is lighter. Seeking isn't free.
slides.body: In the default file only **2 of 150 frames** are keyframes. Jumping to 4.65 s decodes about 38 frames first.
slides.close: A keyframe on every frame (**-g 1**) fixes that, and doubles the file: 3.0 to 5.9 MB.
slides.source: keyframes counted with ffprobe; -g = GOP size (ffmpeg -h full)

slides.name: ScrollTrigger
slides.maker: Part of GSAP. Free, every plugin included.
slides.what: Links an animation's progress to the scrollbar. **scrub: true** locks it to the scroll; **scrub: 1** takes one second to catch up, which feels smoother.
slides.use: Frame sequences, pinned sections, anything scrubbed.

slides.name: Lenis
slides.what: Smooths the wheel but **runs on native scroll**, so position: sticky, anchor links and accessibility keep working. Its README shows the ScrollTrigger hookup.
slides.use: Scrub sections that feel steppy on a mouse wheel.

slides.title: CSS scrubs now.
slides.body: **animation-timeline: scroll()** ties a CSS animation to scroll. Chrome since 115, Safari since 26, and Firefox adds it in **159, due 27 Oct**.
slides.close: Great for reveals and progress bars. Frame sequences still need a canvas.

slides.title: Ship frames light.
slides.body: WebP at the size it's shown, half size on phones, and the first 20 frames before anything else. Use video only with a keyframe on every frame.
slides.note: Test on a mid-range phone. Smooth on a MacBook proves nothing.
slides.cta: Save this for your next build.
